summary: Reconstructed the figure as compilable standalone TikZ (version 1, compiled and validated). It shows a semicircle with diameter MN and center O, a vertical radius OP, point A on OP, and point B on the arc, joined to O and A. All six labels (P, B, A, O, M, N) were bound by CV and confirmed in the critic's labels check. The critic scored it 0.92 with must_repair=false. Its only note is a low-severity one: filled dots appear at M, N and P, which the original does not show.

Reconstructed the figure as a compilable standalone TikZ trapezoid ABCD (version 1, compiled and validated). Vertices come from CV bindings: A=(67.4,243), B=(460.4,243), C=(381.6,46), D=(146.4,46) px. Sides AB, BC, CD, DA are solid, with AB parallel to DC. No circles or right-angle marks were verified, so none were drawn. The critic scored it 0.9 with checklist 1.0 and must_repair=false. All four labels A, B, C, D are present.

Reconstructed the figure as a trapezoid ABCD. CV found four solid segments and bound labels A (top-left), B (bottom-left), C (bottom-right), D (top-right) with no unmatched labels. No circles or right-angle marks were detected. TikZ v1 compiles, is critic-scored 0.9, and is the best version. Vertices and labels match the original. v2 (thin 0.6pt strokes) was scored 0.85 and the critic's stroke-weight verdict flipped between versions, so I kept v1.

Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ quadrilateral ABCD (AD parallel to BC) with both diagonals AC and BD, the crossing point left unlabelled. Vertex labels A, B, C, D were bound by CV and confirmed visually. Version 2 is best: it compiled, and the critic scored it 0.9 with no must_repair flag, no extra labels, and no missing labels. No right-angle marks were verified, so none are drawn.

Reconstructed the figure as a TikZ trapezoid ABCD (AD parallel to BC) with solid diagonal BD, labels A, B, C, D bound by CV and confirmed by the critic. The only remaining issue is a low-severity note that the labels are slightly smaller and lighter than the original. No right-angle marks or circles were claimed.

The only open note is a low-severity 4 to 5 px offset of C. No right-angle marks were added, since detect_right_angle_marker verified none at A or B.
